title: A Reproducibility Study of Partial Residual Ablations in Pre-LN Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2608.14689v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Residual connections are a fundamental component of transformer architectures, yet the roles of the attention and feed-forward residual pathways remain poorly understood when considered independently. This paper presents a reproducibility study of partial residual ablations in Pre-LN GPT-style transformers trained at two scales (10M and 124M parameters).   I compare four architectural configurations by selectively removing the attention residual connection, the feed-forward residual connection, or both. Across all experiments, removing the attention residual (FFNOnly) consistently causes deterministic collapse to the No-Residual performance floor. In contrast, removing the feed-forward residual (AttnOnly) exhibits a reproducible recovery effect at 10M scale under a controlled 8-seed deterministic study, while its behavior at 124M remains unresolved because of substantial seed variance. translated_title: 预层归一化Transformer中部分残差消融的可复现性研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14689v1 公告类型：新论文  摘要：残差连接是Transformer架构的基本组成部分，然而当独立考虑时，注意力残差路径和前馈残差路径的作用仍未被充分理解。本文对在两种规模（1000万和1.24亿参数）下训练的预层归一化GPT风格Transformer进行了部分残差消融的可复现性研究。我通过选择性地移除注意力残差连接、前馈残差连接或两者，比较了四种架构配置。在所有实验中，移除注意力残差（仅前馈网络）一致性地导致确定性坍缩至无残差性能下限。相反，移除前馈残差（仅注意力）在受控的8种子确定性研究下，在1000万规模表现出可复现的恢复效应，而在1.24亿规模下的行为因显著的种子方差而仍未解决。在调查过程中，我识别并纠正了...
tldr: 该研究通过系统消融实验发现，移除注意力残差连接会导致Transformer性能确定性坍缩，而移除前馈残差在较小规模下表现出可复现的恢复效应，并修正了原始研究中的错误。
en_tdlr: This study systematically ablates residual connections in Pre-LN Transformers, finding that removing attention residuals causes deterministic performance collapse while removing feed-forward residuals shows a reproducible recovery effect at smaller scale, and corrects errors in the original research.
